Corrected the settlement section to what the code does: a fresh discard refuses a moved or elsewhere-checked-out branch and only completing an earlier discard keeps it; the kept base must be a local or remote-tracking branch (refs/heads/<name> before tags, any HEAD spelling, detached refused, tags and commit ids refused); afterCleanup is observed state, not attribution; preserve leaves a symlinked path untouched; ignoredEntries counts every listed ignored path; concurrent same-key retries may both run git. Checked against worktree-provisioning-service.ts (resolveBaseBranch, branchCheckouts with prunable, observeSessionWorktree), the service, the store's strict owner decode and column guard, and the tests (46 in the service and store files, all passing).
